h1: Custom Drinkware Packaging: Product Packs and Cartons
lead: Use the product packing specification as the starting point for your order. Define the individual pack, any gift presentation and the shipping carton as separate parts of the project.
html:
Read the carton information correctly

Carton dimensions describe the outer box, not the cup size. Pieces or sets per carton and the listed carton weight serve the shipment plan; keep their units attached.

Plan the sales or event pack

State whether the order needs individual presentation, a multi-item set or bulk packing. The quotation records the selected contents and packing arrangement without treating a concept image as a confirmed carton specification.

Questions Before You Order
